items.meta_title: What Is Cost to Serve? Definition and Drivers

items.angle: Ranking pages are logistics/AP-automation glossaries that stop at a formula. items.serp_notes: Observed: vendor glossaries (Hyperbots, Capterra, EasyMetrics, logistics firms) and a few how-to blogs. Mostly definition + generic formula; logistics-centric.
